title: Tech Note: Building Applications with 4D 2004: Automatic Client Upgrade
author: Josh Fletcher, Technical Support Engineer, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: 4D Build Application XML Keys (BuildCSUpgradeable, CurrentVers, RangeVersMin/Max)

historical_commentary.text: This note documents 4D 2004's automatic client upgrade feature, which lets a merged 4D Server automatically push a full client-software upgrade (not just method/form updates, which 4D already handled) via Build Application XML keys and platform-specific install scripts. The client/server versioning and forced-upgrade concept remains conceptually relevant to any client/server software distribution model, but the concrete mechanism — merged, double-clickable 4D Client applications with .4DC compiled structures, XML BuildApplication keys, and batch/shell upgrade scripts — is tied to the pre-Project-Mode, pre-web-client 4D deployment model of that era.
related_updates: 4D has continued to evolve its Build Application / deployment tooling substantially since 2004-2007
Many modern 4D deployments favor 4D's web server-based clients or updated client/server distribution tooling over merged double-clickable client upgrades
4D v11 (later in 2007) introduced 4D's first native SQL engine, unrelated to this note's client-upgrade topic but marking this as a pre-v11 document
